scores.label: A
scores.note: Option 4 is 0: 'found' becomes 'suggests' (hedge changes certainty) and 'said' becomes 'believe'. 2 'almost 50 percent' keeps the fact (warn only); 3 turns survey into study and repeats 'felt...feel'; 5 'contributed to' softens the claim.

scores.label: B
scores.note: Options 1 and 2 are 0: they drop social media as the cause, changing the finding. Option 3 is 0: 'suggests' hedges the certainty and 'research' replaces the survey. 4 is a clean academic rewrite; 5 is plain ('feel bad') and 'teen population' overgeneralizes slightly.
